research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01: frozen official extract, full first speech, official party biography, ABC selection reporting, indexed council historical management record, parliamentary hearing appendix and public LinkedIn index checked. Roster unchanged.

Need call-centre start/end dates and identity of second operator; do not assign another Devonport company merely from closures. Age 17 and retrospective references do not justify invented 1 January dates. Full-time evidence from call centres does not transfer to Kmart, ATO or fitness work.

ATO tenure conflict retained: official 2005–18 versus retrospective 15 years. Sabbatical could preserve an employment relationship after active work ended; do not count ATO leave and CPSU service twice. Obtain contemporary dated employment/separation or leave evidence before any calculation.

Fitness dates, hours, legal employer and employment/contractor status missing; no inference that instruction preceded ATO employment. Council-owned facility with private management is not automatic public employment. Council PDF size error is a source gap, not run blocker.

Targeted CPSU, Sitel, fitness and publicly indexed professional-history searches did not supply missing dates/hours. Professional profile job ads concern his staff, not his own employment. Follow-up: employer/council historical instructor records, Sitel and other call-centre employment dates, ATO hours/leave/separation and exact union transitions.

Follow-up2026-10-02: primary2016AEC uncontested election declaration identifies Hobart Tax Section Councillor and dated election event; separated from earlier workplace delegation to avoid invented2014councillor commencement. Contemporary office election is material corroboration but not salaried employment.

New August2025radio interview transcript repeats approximate ATO duration and move; discrepancy remains. Public professional index exposes no historical titles/dates. Targeted second call-centre, instructor and2018/2019union-transition searches did not identify missing employers/hours. Do not assign Salmat or Belgravia merely because they operated locally.
